title: United States and Iran on the Brink: What's at Stake?
summary: CSIS panel weighs US-Iran brinkmanship in early 2026: failed trust in talks, Gulf mediation, Iran's likely harder retaliation and roughly even odds of war.

assertions.quote: In my opinion, the more likely scenario isn't full closure. It's it's asymmetric disruption, targeted harassment, forcing rerouting, raising insurance premiums
so I think a much larger war is is strategically to Iran. They're thinking is strategically to their advantage.

verdicts.note: In the 2026 war Iran fired thousands of drones and missiles at Israel and Gulf states and shut Hormuz, unlike its token strike on Al Udeid in 2025.
Unlike its limited response in June 2025, Iran answered the 2026 attack by closing the Strait of Hormuz, bringing the region to the brink of a wider war.

assertions.quote: I think they're not going to go after the straits of hormones. They're going to go after oil production.

verdicts.note: When the 2026 war came, shipping through Hormuz was halted, so Iran did not spare the strait.
When attacked in 2026, Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz, and reopening it became the US condition for a truce.

assertions.quote: I'm not convinced that we've seen the end of US andor Israeli uh strikes.

verdicts.note: The US and Israel opened a military campaign against Iran at the end of February 2026.
Polymarket gives only 29% that the US-Iran ceasefire survives to December 31, 2026, i.e. about 71% that the US strikes Iran again this year (Israeli strikes are not counted).
After the June 2025 war, the US and Israel launched a wide-scale military operation against Iran on 28 February 2026 that lasted until 8 April.
PRIO (June 2026) says the Middle East escalation continued in 2026 with the USA-Iran war.

assertions.quote: but there hasn't been enrichment over the last seven, eight months because they can't.

verdicts.note: Before the 2025 strikes Iran could make weapons-grade uranium within weeks, but a deliverable weapon was judged months to a year or more away, and the strikes set it back.

assertions.quote: Regional actors, including key Gulf states, have encouraged the Trump administration to seek a negotiated solution.

verdicts.note: Oman hosted the talks and Saudi, Qatari and other Gulf leaders publicly urged a negotiated outcome to protect their economies.
Under pressure from regional allies Trump backed down from his March 2026 ultimatum to strike Iran's energy facilities, which is pressure for restraint during the war rather than before it.

assertions.quote: Well when when the Houthies say something they generally do it. the evidence really indicates that that yes, they they'd attack.

verdicts.note: The Houthis attacked Red Sea shipping and US ships in earlier rounds, but how fully they joined the 2026 war is not clear from the record at hand.
